notes: Section: p. 56 rows 3-4 only (under 'PLATE XI.—Upper Register.'), stopping at the horizontal rule; p. 57 all rows; p. 58 all rows; p. 59 rows 1-9 up to 'Re - stau.' before 'The Fourth Ārit. 1.'. My row counts: p. 56 2 rows read, p. 57 9 hieroglyphic rows (the brief says 10; its 'row 9 [D21 A1]' is my row 8, line 9 'er - à'), p. 58 9 rows (brief says 11), p. 59 9 rows (last row partial). Hall 1 lines 1-17 (p. 56 l.1 to p. 58 l.17); Hall 2 lines 1-9 (p. 58 to p. 59 row 1); Hall 3 lines 1-8 (p. 59 rows 2-9). Overlines (rubric): p. 56 ārit ṭep; ren (row 2, first); ren en (row 2, second); p. 57 t'eṭtu àn; ārit ṭept; ànet'-ḥrà-k; neb à rer en; p. 58 ārit sen (hall 2); ten ḥems-f ḥer; àrit ṭep em χemet ut'ā (overline ends just over ut'ā); p. 59 ārit χemt (hall 3); t'eṭ àn. Restorations: p. 56 [N35] en; p. 57 [D21 A1] er-à; p. 58 [àrit] (D4 X1); p. 58 [O34 O34] split between sati-s and Seqeṭ; p. 59 unχ [V12-like loop + U15]. (sic): p. 58 ent and Maāta (over N35); p. 59 at-f ((sic) beside N5). No hatched lacunae seen in Ani's text. Recurrent kneeling figure with arm raised diagonally to the face (ren, semà, χeru, à) coded A2; kneeling figure with arm raised freely (nuk, first person) coded A1; seated wrapped figure with wig, no beard, coded A40 after divine names, A1 elsewhere. Words split across rows: àneb (p. 57 row 8) continues with wall sign + -f on row 9 (recorded as a separate word '- f'); Qeq-ḥauatu- continues on p. 59 row 3 with G43 Aa2 Z2 (merged into the one word). Spans Budge prints as one ('àrit uat - f', 'àri-nà seχen') split into separate words.
